decisions.summary: SEATING_GROUND_FT = 162, the side of a square holding the pool's mean envelope plus the least wood floor, sizing _seat_households' lattice and seat bound
decisions.why: FR-010 (both the accepted and the amended text) and the spec's Decisions table settle the figure, its derivation from measured homesteads and its class (a labeled guess).

decisions.summary: The margin's choice, the canvas's room and the belt keep HOMESTEAD_GROUND_FT's 104; maps do not start larger
decisions.why: The GM's larger-maps line is conditional in its own words ('If the thing that is stopping us ... is the margin in the sense of being the edge of the map'). R12 measured the condition false (the canvas grown alone with the band at 104 made 40 households worse: seed 39, 42 margins, 216 s), and growing canvas, margin and belt with the band refused sites the base seated (R11: cohort 30/30 -> 27/30, Sawada refused), which FR-008 forbids. The exception is implied by the GM's own condition, not by cost.

decisions.summary: D1's own FR-011 verdict stated as GO from R12 (11 of 16 on the first margin, 84.2 s summed against the base's ~449)
decisions.why: FR-011 builds each lever only on its OWN verdict. R12 was measured on the clone's engine with the dry cap and the rescue already in it (commit 9dc315843, before R12's d9c27b02f; capacity.py DRY_SPELL=400, RESCUE_SHORT=3), so 84.2 s is D1 plus D2, not D1. The ~449 base sum is not back to back with it (R7's sweep ran four to six processes at once; FR-009 asks base and clone back to back) and no per-seed base appears in research. Fix: on the final form, run the sixteen-seed set at 40 households back to back - base, D1 alone (dry cap and rescue off), D1 with both - record it as a new research entry, and state D1's verdict from the D1-alone leg.

decisions.summary: Rescue and dry-spell cap built only if they pay on top of D1, the evidence named R9
decisions.why: The rule is FR-011, but the measurement it names is not of it: R9 measured both on top of HOMESTEAD_GROUND_FT=162 grown everywhere, the form of D1 that R11-R12 withdrew because the canvas's room changes the outcome materially (R12). Both levers are already in the engine. Under the final D1 (11 of 16 on the first margin) whether a near-miss rescue still pays is unmeasured; building on a premise nobody measured on the configuration being built narrows FR-011. Fix: the D1-alone vs D1-with-both legs of the same back-to-back run; build or withdraw each lever from it (each separately if they differ).

decisions.summary: FR-003 and FR-004 not built: FR-004 prototyped NO-GO (R3, R4); FR-003's free-ground form disproved (R1), its rules-based form argued and not prototyped; reference-seed misses recorded and raised
decisions.why: FR-011 builds no lever without its own GO, and FR-002's further rounds were run (R5-R7, R9, R11, R12). Round 1's notes are addressed. Note: 'under D1's final form on the first (R12)' for seed 47 is not in R12, which gives only 11 of 16 and the worst 14.1 s; R11 gives seed 47 at 3.6 s on a different form. Restate from the new run.

decisions.summary: Census armed on _geom primitives, overlap.py predicates and shapely's binary predicates and distance; comparisons in C over arrays not seen
decisions.why: Round 1's fix is in the tool (overlap_census.py _SHAPELY). The stated remaining limit is real for sys.monitoring, and the engine's vectorized shapely calls checked (boundary.py 321-337 raster blocks and cells, indexes.py and yards.py intersects_xy/contains_xy grids, tint.py one distance per plot computed once, partition.py) are rasters being built or each item's own measurement - the boxes and rasters the GM's rule asks for, not scans standing in for them.

decisions.why: The spec delegates the threshold to the plan from the measured distribution. Note: the tail values the plan now lists (2,631, 2,624, 1,857, 1,799, 1,725) are attributed to R10 but R10 does not contain them; add them to R10 from its run.
